line_items.work_text: Immediate Restoration on Nikaripara Road to give connectivity toward villages Meserbihita , Baniapara, Sonalurtal, Paschim simbulrul by providing slab culvert including approaches and protection works at breached location under SDRF for the year 2022-23
Approval of SDRF Proposals of Power Department for year 2022-23 for immediate restoration of LT lines, poles and Transformers damaged due to storm under Charaideo Electrical Sub-Division
SDRF proposals of PWD Roads Department for the year 2022-23
Approval of estimate for the waterproofing work for the roof top of ASDMA Office building

narrative: SEC directed Public Works Roads Department to arrange payment for work not eligible under SDRF norms. SEC approved proposals for restoration works and directed departments to adhere to SDRF norms.
